page_title: OSA 1-0 MAL | Osasuna v Mallorca 24/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.

90+4' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Sergio Herrera intercepts the ball.
88' Adrian Cordero Vega shows a yellow card to Cyle Larin (Mallorca) for his blatant foul.

87' Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header would probably have ended up low inside the middle of the goal, but Dominik Greif pulls off a comfortable save to thwart him.
87' The referee blows his whistle as Johan Mojica (Mallorca) was too aggressive in his challenge. Osasuna get a free kick.
85' That will be all from Sergi Darder who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Abdon Prats (Mallorca).
85' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Osasuna was in an offside position.
84' Mallorca concede a free kick after one of their players holds onto an opposition player. Osasuna are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
83' Problems for Vicente Moreno as Iker Munoz is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) replaces him.
82' Looks like Iker Munoz (Osasuna) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
80' It will be a substitution. Iker Munoz (Osasuna) is ready to enter the pitch as Aimar Oroz walks off.
79' Substitution. Raul Garcia (Osasuna) replaces Ante Budimir.
79' Vicente Moreno has decided to substitute Jesus Areso and he is replaced by Nacho Vidal (Osasuna).
79' We are about to witness a subsitution. Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) for Sergi Darder.
77' Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
75' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
74' The shots on goal statistics – 4:2.
71' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ruben Garcia.
70' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Samu Costa (Mallorca). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
68' Vedat Muriqi nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Manu Morlanes (Mallorca), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance.
67' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Dominik Greif, who smothers the ball.
65' A quickly taken corner by Osasuna.

64' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick.
62' Here is a change. Takuma Asano is going off and Jagoba Arrasate gives the last tactical orders to Cyle Larin (Mallorca).
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) comes onto the pitch so that Omar Mascarell can be given a rest.
61' A corner kick by Mallorca is thwarted by the well prepared Sergio Herrera (Osasuna).
61' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Mallorca are awarded a corner kick.
61' Mallorca failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
60' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Takuma Asano (Mallorca). Mallorca have been awarded a corner kick.
60' That was close. Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
59' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.

58' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Adrian Cordero Vega no option but to blow his whistle. That's a free kick to Osasuna.
55' 1 - 0 Goal 1:0! Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
55' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
54' The attendance is 19900.
53' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) sends a cross into the box, but Sergio Herrera comes off his line to gather the ball.
50' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards over the bar.
49' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Adrian Cordero Vega has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Mallorca win a free kick.

49' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) latches on to a fine cross from the resulting corner kick and attempts to finish from the edge of the box. His shot, however, misses the target narrowly wide of the right post.
48' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) works the corner short.
47' A lofted cross from Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Now Osasuna have a corner.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Johan Mojica swings the cross over. Takuma Asano (Mallorca) gets his head to it but it goes just over the crossbar.
45+1' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca).
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' Adrian Cordero Vega interrupts the game. One of the players from Osasuna won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Mallorca have a free kick.

41' A player from Osasuna commits a rough challenge. Adrian Cordero Vega blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. It's a free kick to Mallorca, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
40' A pass from Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is intercepted by Dominik Greif and the move breaks down.

39' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) attempts to beat the goalkeeper with an accurate shot from the free kick, which is placed dangerously close to the penalty area. However, Dominik Greif pulls off a great save to deny his drilled attempt towards the middle of the goal.
38' Samu Costa (Mallorca) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Adrian Cordero Vega signals. Osasuna are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
37' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
36' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
33' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) picked up a rebound and unleashed a fine effort which crashed against the right post.
33' Osasuna take a short corner kick.

32' A snap shot by Ante Budimir (Osasuna) from the edge of the area flies towards the left side of the goal, but Dominik Greif produces a good save to thwart him. It will be a corner kick for Osasuna.
31' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Adrian Cordero Vega blows for a foul. Osasuna will take a free kick near the side line.
30' Adrian Cordero Vega interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Alejandro Catena (Osasuna). Mallorca have a free kick.
26' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
23' Mallorca work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
23' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) hits an explosive shot from outside the penalty area and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save. Mallorca get a corner.
18' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) hits a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a comfortable save for Dominik Greif as it's directed low at the middle of the goal.
16' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
13' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.

11' What a chance that is! Ante Budimir (Osasuna) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes well wide of the right post!
11' Osasuna quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
10' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
8' A cross into the box picks out Takuma Asano (Mallorca), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot well wide of the left post.
5' Osasuna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
4' A pass by Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. Osasuna earn a corner.
2' A cross from Abel Bretones (Osasuna) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Mallorca will have the kick-off.
Adrian Cordero Vega will referee today's match.
